headline: Fronts Stir Along the Contested Belt
war_summary: The latest returns show the strategic front stirring anew since the previous edition. Marban Hollow has become the freshest crisis, with five base events in the last two hours, violent casualty acceleration on both sides, and activity concentrated at Checkpoint Bua and Maiden’s Veil. Nevish Line remains the broadest moving front: 47 events are recorded for the day, including four recently, while its ledger now stands at six Warden and two Colonial bases. Palantine Berm has also come alive, posting five events in two hours and 36 across the day amid rising losses and enlistments. Weathered Expanse reports three fresh events and 21 daily, with casualties accelerating and seven Colonial bases against two Warden. Callahan’s Passage remains the war’s great grinder, with 29 daily events and enormous losses, though its latest two-hour ledger is quiet. Kuura Strand’s earlier turmoil has cooled sharply, but 21 daily events leave it worth watching. Most other sectors show little strategic movement. No victor is recorded.
